title: Tehran- Oct 16, Mohammad Akraminia, the Iranian army Spokesperson, made remarks in a TV talk show.
text:
Tehran- Oct 16, Mohammad Akraminia, the Iranian army Spokesperson, made remarks in a TV talk show."

""
"SOT1, Mohammad Akraminia, spokesman for the Iranian army (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:39): "As you have noted, we have shot down several American drones in the country's airspace within this past weeks. This demonstrates that our air defense force is still operating with power. I must inform you that new operational and equipment plans have been prepared by our air defense force under the Air Defense Headquarters, which is recognized as one of the units of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army, and these plans have been implemented, playing a very effective role today in enhancing the combat capabilities of the air defense.""

"SOT2, Mohammad Akraminia, spokesman for the Iranian army (Farsi)-(00:40 - 01:09): "Today, compared to the days of the war and before the war, we have significantly strengthened the country's air defense coverage, both in terms of operational tactics and in terms of equipment. Many of the pieces of equipment that were damaged during the war have been repaired and returned to service, and new equipment has also been introduced into the combat organization, which has effectively increased this coverage.""

"SOT3, Mohammad Akraminia, spokesman for the Iranian army (Farsi)-(01:10 - 02:01): "From the west of the Strait of Hormuz to the Persian Gulf, control is effectively held by the Navy of the IRGC, and to the east of the Strait. the Sea of Oman, the Arabian Sea, and the northern Indian Ocean, control is effectively held by the Navy of the Army. The Army's Navy has complete intelligence dominance in this vast region. As for the new measures they have taken, you can see that the outcome of these actions today has resulted in the fact that, despite the U.S. President's claim that we control the Strait of Hormuz, even putting his own name on the Strait, they do not dare approach it and remain more than 500 kilometers away from the coasts.""

"SOT4, Mohammad Akraminia, spokesman for the Iranian army (Farsi)-(02:02 - 02:37): "This insecurity that we see today in the Strait of Hormuz, which primarily begins in the eastern region of the Strait and extends through the Strait itself, is due to the presence and interference of the United States. Before this war, this region was actually a calm and stable area. However, by instigating this war with their malice and interference, the Americans have effectively made this region insecure and dealt blows to the global economy and the economies of regional countries.""

""
"SOT5, Mohammad Akraminia, spokesman for the Iranian army: "We must help by creating a local mechanism to expel the presence of American countries from the region. I believe that only the expulsion of the United States can bring peace and tranquility to the region, and God willing, this will happen. Ship owners must also know that  only coordination with the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran  can ensure a safe passage for them.
